value.rationale: Sharp positive-distance alphabet complexity is a naturally motivated compression invariant for finite-parameter modal frame models. The theorem gives a carrier-size-independent optimal exact formula for all ratios, with an explicit construction and minimal witnesses, a quantitative question not answered by general qualitative metric representability. This is a complete sharp classification rather than an arbitrary slice or a trivial parameter renaming.
